name: databricks-genie
description: Ask Databricks Genie about your governed data from Antigravity and turn its answers and SQL into code. Signs in with your Databricks CLI.
suggestedPrompts: Ask Genie which products drove the most revenue last quarter, and show the SQL it ran
Ask Genie how last quarter's revenue breaks down by region, and show the SQL it ran
Ask Genie for monthly revenue by product, and save the SQL it ran as a query file in this project
